---
title: Installation
---

Install in the project where you want to use the skill. Node 22.20.0 or newer
and Git are prerequisites for the tested skills CLI. The compatibility checks
use **skills 1.7.0**; omit the version to use the current release.

## Discover the authored collection

```bash
npx skills@1.7.0 add butterlyn/engineering-skills --list
npx skills@1.7.0 add https://butterlyn.github.io/engineering-skills/ --list
```

## Install one skill

```bash
npx skills@1.7.0 add butterlyn/engineering-skills --skill verify-a-change --agent codex --copy --yes
npx skills@1.7.0 add https://butterlyn.github.io/engineering-skills/ --skill verify-a-change --agent codex --copy --yes
```

The repository and website routes include the skill's reference template and
license. The direct `skill.md` convenience URL contains only the primary
instructions; use the collection URL to receive companion files.

Replace `codex` with the appropriate identifier:

| Agent | CLI identifier | Tested project directory |
|---|---|---|
| Codex | `codex` | `.agents/skills/` |
| Claude Code | `claude-code` | `.claude/skills/` |
| pi-coding-agent | `pi` | `.pi/skills/` |
| OpenCode | `opencode` | `.agents/skills/` |

## Install the complete authored collection

```bash
npx skills@1.7.0 add butterlyn/engineering-skills --skill '*' --agent codex claude-code pi opencode --copy --yes
npx skills@1.7.0 add https://butterlyn.github.io/engineering-skills/ --skill '*' --agent codex claude-code pi opencode --copy --yes
```

`--copy` avoids symlink requirements. Omit it for the installer's default
symlink method. These are project installations; adding `--global` changes
their scope. Our checks use disposable projects and never use `--global`.

Review changes before running `npx skills update`. Git installs are the
durable fallback if an installer version fails website discovery. Always use
the full `/engineering-skills/` project URL: the domain root belongs to a
different Pages scope.

Installation verifies file placement, not that an agent follows the
instructions. See the repository's [verification record](https://github.com/butterlyn/engineering-skills/blob/main/VERIFICATION.md)
for executed checks, versions, and behavioral gaps.
